interpretation.accepted: Bounded assisted full-party execution: attacks, voluntary/forced switching, accepted/declined opponent-change prompts and actual late-slot transitions completed under frozen J.
interpretation.not_established: Natural trainer or League competence, efficient target selection, profitable income or general six-party production qualification. Six wins from two constructed origin clusters are not a population reliability estimate.
interpretation.observed_weakness: Every case first switched to slot3; the last-slot electric option was not used until decision15-17. Repeated switching and14 faints warrant a bounded TRAIN-only strategy comparison, not executor redesign or hand-selected policy actions.
interpretation.coverage_gap: Slot5 was exercised in both five-member cases but never activated in either six-member case. No claim that all slots were played within each six-member battle.
interpretation.terminal_caveat: The lab-rival script restored HP/PP at battle exit in all six cases. Full terminal HP does not erase in-battle faints or establish economic recovery. Observed boundary-delta HP/PP metrics can undercount final-turn use across that restoration.
interpretation.funding_contract: All six have in-battle faints and therefore do not satisfy the existing ordinary-funding no-faints contract. That guard is unchanged; no new universal no-faints requirement is imposed.
